title: Same nested shape, rescued by explicit arrayPaths with inference off
rationale: The third arm of the gate on the same document as nested-array-of-objects-default: prove the reconstructor CAN represent this shape, so the defect is provably in the auto-detection heuristic and not an inherent limit of the flattened form. Without this fixture the previous one is unactionable.
catchesBugClass: That the arrayPaths hint and the inferArraysFromValues switch are live controls, not decoration. If either is refactored into a no-op this fixture flips from pass to fail while its DEFECT twin keeps failing - the signature the repo keeps missing.
cannotCatch: It cannot claim the library is usable this way in practice: the config requires the caller to already know the document array paths, which defeats the schema-less premise. It also does not generalise - arrayPaths matches whole encoded prefixes exactly.

predicted.detail: With inference disabled only the configured path order_items enters analysis.arrayPaths; order stays an object path and the array rebuilds exactly.
